formulaSources.evidence: Square and triangular precipitation include 360 / sprinkler arc. Run-time = desired application × 60 / precipitation rate.
Metric PR = 1000 × m³/h / (S × L); triangular row spacing L = S × 0.866.
Explains metric flow per spacing area, half-circle discharge contribution and triangular head-to-head spacing.

calculationPolicy.use: UI approximation only when published sector rate is null and same-point flow/radius are available and verified; retain raw nulls.
calculationPolicy.spacingAssumption: Head-to-head: spacingM equals full published throw radius at the operating pressure. This is a regular-grid reference, not a measured site-wide application rate.
guards: Sector geometry only; do not apply generic radius formula to strips, point bubblers, square patterns or unsupported specialty shapes.
Require finite positive flow, radius and arc and valid supported nozzle/pressure/arc.
Do not restore flow or infer it for manually reduced radii whose flow is unpublished.
If source pressure values are interpolated, keep the result labelled calculated/interpolated, not published.
Do not overwrite valid published precipitation cells, manufacturer source rows, or stored project hydraulic snapshots.
Use selected actual arc once; do not multiply by the source reference arc again.
Runtime is a derived reference for the stated spacing and depth; no efficiency or distribution-uniformity correction is implied.
